title: Pauli Contextuality Lab: Unified Lean 4.35.0 Formalization of Spectral Bounds, Disjoint Mermin Configurations, and Sequential Contextuality Evidence
description: Consolidates the four archived Pauli/Mermin contextuality repositories into one unified Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 monorepo meeting Build Standard v1.2.0 (100.0%, 68/68 checks, Core 30/30) and Playbook v1.3. Ships a pinned Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 workspace (68 .lean files; all 9 standalone Track 1 finite-certificate modules live-audited in parallel CI via VerifyStandalone.lean and VerifyPhaseSeven.lean), searchable 32-node / 251-declaration Lean Blueprint with MathJax SRI, explicit Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism verifier & hyperbolic quasi-quadric (135/1,095/75) Qontextium exports, 4 zero-overflow Tectonic PDFs (0.00pt max overfull), and 3-OS + 15-engine C11 ASan/UBSan CI (run 46070500824, adding w15_verify.c). Track 1 formalizes Jonah's universal and Kramers spectral floors, two-sided asymptotic 1/2 limits, five-way saturation equivalences, finite flat degrees 75, 480, 2016 and 729344, infinite non-closed pure-CCZ family |Psi_{3m}> (m>=1, contextual m>=2), lower bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q+(9,2))>=6444, exact four-qubit C3 binary completion optima (368 vs 344), formal geometric vertex-case membership IsCaseC1-IsCaseC15 + strict-law failure for one representative per case for all N>=4, 13 non-vacuity witnesses + 11 kernel-proved perturbed-bound refutations, and Theorems 23-25 answering M. Saniga's Nov 2026 correspondence (TrialityResiduals.lean: exact Q+(7,2) 315-line deletion degrees 0, universal spread 210, universal Q(6,2) 252, triality-dual ovoid 252 beating floor 204 by +48; PGRigidity.lean: pure-algebra all-N PG(N-1,2) rigidity forcing >= 166,115,415 on W(15,2) vs C11 verified witness 161,360,335 and Q+(15,2) witness 38,088,999; DesarguesQuasiQuadric.lean: universal all-N [DHOP] fiber-flip 71/63 law, Desargues (10_3), ovoid context parabola 1575 - 256k + 32k^2, decoupling/non-saturation of S_B^+, and sharp Mermin-Peres brackets on K_95, K_103, S_B^(4), S_B^+) plus M. Saniga et al.'s private-communication section & Figure 2b. Track 2 formalizes 100% of Eqs. 1-16 (GeneralTheory.lean, ActualModel.lean, SeedSupport.lean), answering Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1 Sec. 6) with corrected 6.32%/5.99% readout-noise thresholds. Track 3 proves finite adaptive-tree sequential evidence bounds and a sharp Peres-Mermin setting-bias attack. All 3 parallel Lean CI jobs (run 46070500853) passed 100% green: 255 explicit + 2,798 exhaustive axioms, live tamper-injection negative gate, 18-module Batteries linter, 30 targets across 6 independent kernels (SLSA #73290357), VerifyStandalone (SLSA #73294858), VerifyPhaseSeven (SLSA #73283417), Release v3.4.0 (SLSA #73282667).
